title: From tourism to power generation and productivity, Europe feels economic cost of heatwaves

paragraphs.en: Across Europe this scorching summer, workers have struggled in the heat as wildfires raged and critical infrastructure was shut down.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个酷热的夏天，欧洲各地野火肆虐、关键基础设施停运，工人们在高温下艰难工作。

paragraphs.en: Here we look at the impact of the heatwaves on several major economies across mainland Europe – with the help of analysis from economists at the Dutch bank Triodos , who estimate a total of €180bn could be wiped off EU GDP by the heatwaves. In the UK, the green thinktank Verdant said this week that the heat had already cost the economy £4.4bn by the end of July.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里，我们借助荷兰银行Triodos经济学家的分析，探讨热浪对欧洲大陆多个主要经济体的影响。他们估计，热浪可能使欧盟GDP总共损失1800亿欧元。在英国，绿色智库Verdant本周表示，截至7月底，高温已经给英国经济造成44亿英镑的损失。

paragraphs.en: Research shows productivity tends to decline once temperatures breach 30C. Analysts at Triodos assessed the hit to each country on the basis of factors including how many unusually hot days it has suffered, giving a broad-brush estimate – but each economy also faces its own particular struggles.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明，一旦气温突破30摄氏度，生产率往往会下降。Triodos的分析师根据各国经历的异常高温天数等因素评估了其对各国的影响，给出了一个粗略估计——但每个经济体也面临着各自特有的困难。

paragraphs.en: As well as widespread wildfires, one of the big challenges for the French economy has come via lost energy output, with knock-on effects for businesses through higher prices.
paragraphs.zh: 除了大范围的野火之外，法国经济面临的重大挑战之一来自电力产出的损失，并通过价格上涨对工商企业产生了连锁影响。

paragraphs.en: More than two-thirds of France’s electricity generation comes from nuclear. When river temperatures around these nuclear plants get too high, the facilities can no longer discharge heat into them – and have no choice but to shut down .
paragraphs.zh: 法国超过三分之二的电力来自核电。当核电站周围河流的水温过高时，这些设施便无法再向河中排放热量——别无选择，只能停机。

paragraphs.en: On Friday, with temperatures soaring once again, up to 15% of the country’s nuclear estate was expected to be offline.
paragraphs.zh: 上周五，随着气温再度飙升，预计该国多达15%的核电装机将停运。

paragraphs.en: Economists at Triodos believe France could be one of the worst hit European economies, with 1.4 percentage points knocked off GDP – pushing the economy into reverse.
paragraphs.zh: Triodos的经济学家认为，法国可能是受冲击最严重的欧洲经济体之一，GDP将损失1.4个百分点——使经济陷入衰退。

paragraphs.en: That is only likely to exacerbate the country’s continuing fiscal challenges, with Paris already paying the highest interest rate in 15 years on its borrowing amid political wrangling over tax and spending.
paragraphs.zh: 这很可能只会加剧法国持续存在的财政挑战——在围绕税收和支出的政治角力中，法国政府已经为其借款支付15年来最高的利率。
